--add.meaning: put a chat into a folder; repeat it for more

--after-id.meaning: read what came after this message id; not with --after-time or the --before pair

--after-time.meaning: read what came after this ISO 8601 time, or 2h / 1d ago; not with --after-id or the --before pair

--allow-any-file.meaning: send a --file even from a hidden folder, ~/.ssh or the tool's own folders

--allow-dangerous.meaning: go ahead without the question an ask level puts before a deletion

--allow-mark-read.meaning: offer the tool that marks a chat read; the other person sees it

--allow-moderate.meaning: offer the tool that applies a group's rules — delete others' messages, remove people

--allow-send.note: max's own `mcp` is worded differently until the permission levels (P7) replace these flags there (e13)

--anonymous.meaning: nobody sees who voted for what

--app.meaning: the first time only: how to get this profile's app from my.telegram.org

--as-file.meaning: send every --file as a plain file to download, a video included

--at-time.meaning: let the messenger send it later, even with this machine off: a local time like 2026-09-25T09:00, or 30m

--background.meaning: run as a job that outlives this command; `store jobs show` follows it

--before-id.meaning: read what came before this message id; not with --before-time

--before-time.meaning: read what came before this ISO 8601 time, or 2h / 1d ago; not with --before-id

--bot.meaning: the bot section of the profile's settings, rather than the personal account's

--can.meaning: what they may do, comma-separated: read, members, admins, info, pin, link, post, edit, delete

--channel.meaning: a private channel instead of a group; people join it by its link

--chat.meaning: a chat, by id or name; repeat it for more

--check.meaning: say whether a newer version exists, and install nothing

--confirm-send.meaning: show the owner every write the MCP server offers, in a form to approve

--defaults.meaning: change what every profile gets, rather than this profile

--description.meaning: the new about text — of a chat or of your account

--estimate.meaning: only say what the fetch would cost, from this machine's copy; nothing is sent
--estimate.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--event.meaning: only these events, comma-separated, as the messenger names them

--events.meaning: also print edits, deletions and reactions; every line then names its event

--file.meaning: attach a file; images go as a photo, videos as a video. Repeat it for more

--for.meaning: which agents a skill is installed for: claude, agents or all

--for-everyone.meaning: delete for everyone in the chat, not only for you — they cannot get it back

--format.meaning: jsonl, one message per line, or a markdown transcript

--history.meaning: the people added also see the messages from before they came

--idle.meaning: stop after this long with nobody using it — 15m, 1h

--json.meaning: machine-readable output: one JSON value on stdout, nothing else

--jsonl.meaning: machine-readable output: one JSON object per line, for streaming and jq

--kind.meaning: only chats of this kind: dialog, group, channel or saved

--last.meaning: stop once the newest n messages are held; not with --since
--last.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--left.meaning: only the chats this account has left

--limit.meaning: how many: rows to show, or messages one run fetches
--limit.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--local.meaning: use the model on this machine, never the messenger

--mark-read.meaning: also mark the chat read up to the newest message shown; the other person sees it

--max-actions.meaning: at most this many actions in one run

--md.meaning: read **bold**, _italic_, ~~struck~~ and `code` in the text; \ keeps a mark literal

--members-see-link.meaning: members may see the invite link

--model.meaning: which downloaded speech model hears them; `models audio list` shows them
--model.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--new.meaning: what arrived since the last check, each message once — for scheduled runs

--no-preview.meaning: no preview card for a link in the text

--no-record.meaning: do not keep it, whatever the configuration says

--no-serve.meaning: do not start it; log in on this command's own connection unless one is running

--notify.meaning: tell the chat's members about the pin

--offline.meaning: answer from what was recorded and never connect; fails if nothing was

--online.meaning: also log in once, read one chat and start the MCP server; sends nothing
--online.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--only-admins-call.meaning: only admins may start a call

--only-owner-edits-info.meaning: only the owner may change the name and photo

--others.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--output.meaning: where to write: a directory for `messages download`, a file for `store export`
--output.note: `messages download --output <dir>` becomes `--output-dir`; `--output` stays a file — e10

--output-dir.meaning: the folder to write into, created if missing

--page-size.meaning: how many items one request to the messenger asks for; the messenger's own if not given

--pause.meaning: the least wait between pages, 5s or 500ms; each is up to twice that
--pause.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--personal.meaning: the personal account's section of the profile's settings

--photo.meaning: an image file — a profile photo in `account update`, a photo to send in `messages send`

--qr-file.meaning: write the QR code to this PNG instead of drawing it, for an agent to pass on

--quiet.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--record.meaning: keep this run under `runs` — ids and timings, never message content
--record.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--regex.meaning: the words are one regular expression, case-insensitive, tested against every stored text

--remove.meaning: take a chat out of a folder; repeat it for more

--reply-to.meaning: answer this message id in the same chat

--retract.meaning: take your vote back, where the poll allows it

--run.meaning: the run the report is about; the newest failed one if not given

--search.meaning: only chats whose name contains this; at least 3 characters

--send-id.meaning: reuse the id of an earlier send whose outcome is unknown; the messenger drops the duplicate

--serve.meaning: start `serve` in the background if it is not running (the default)

--since.meaning: from this message id, an ISO 8601 time, or 2h / 1d ago; each command says its default

--since-time.meaning: from this ISO 8601 time, or 2h / 1d ago; each command says its default

--timeout.meaning: give up on the whole command after this — 30s, 2m, 500ms

--title.meaning: the new name — of a chat or a folder

--to.meaning: the chat to forward it to: an id, or part of a chat name
--to.note: the sentence says how to name a chat the messenger's way, so it differs on purpose (Help text rule 4)

--trace.meaning: one line per request on stderr: ids and timings, never message content
--trace.note: max logs one line per request, tg the connection's own lines: the same option, a different mechanism (Help text rule 4)

--transcribe.meaning: hear voice messages not heard yet, on this machine; slow, the model must be downloaded
--transcribe.note: max's own copy is worded differently until T6 moves the command onto the shared one (e13)

--type.meaning: only events of these types, comma-separated, as the messenger names them

--unanswered.meaning: only questions to you or a group's admins that nobody answered, asked at least this long ago — 4h, 1d

--until.meaning: only up to this message id, inclusive; the newest by default

--verbose.meaning: more detail in what is shown: -v ids, -vv everything known

--voice.meaning: send an Ogg Opus file as a voice message, alone, with no text

--yes.meaning: go ahead without the question an ask level puts before a write
